On this page

DA-E07-01 — Business & Publisher Service Endpoint Reference ​

> Navigation: ← Knowledge Base Hub · ← API Contracts Index · Business OpenAPI Spec · AI OpenAPI Spec · API Response Format · BA 9 Domains

Authoritative, code-verified REST and STOMP WebSocket endpoint reference for brandhub-business-service (:8081) and brandhub-publisher-service (:8083), routed through brandhub-api-gateway (:8080 / https://api.brandhub.id.vn).

  • Functional Coverage: All 9 SRS Functional Domains (141 FRs, 3.2.1–3.10.14) + STOMP real-time collaboration + infrastructure health monitoring.
  • Canonical System Roles: Guest, Owner, Manager, Creator, Client, Admin (Roles & Permissions Matrix).
  • Response Envelope: Every REST endpoint returns ApiResponse<T> (204 No Content is never used — see API Response Format).

1. Domain 3.2 — Authentication, Sessions & 2FA (/api/v1/auth/**) ​

Controllers: AuthController, GoogleOAuthController, AccountActivationController (BA Spec).

MethodPathActorsDescription & SRS Alignment
POST/api/v1/auth/registerGuestRegister new user account with email/password (FR 3.2.1)
POST/api/v1/auth/verify-otp · /resend-otpGuestVerify email registration / recovery OTP or resend code
POST/api/v1/auth/activation/verify · /completeGuestComplete one-time account_activation_tokens onboarding (Admin / invite flow)
POST/api/v1/auth/loginGuestAuthenticate credentials; returns RS256 accessToken (15m) + HttpOnly refreshToken (30d) or 2FA challenge (FR 3.2.2)
GET/api/v1/auth/oauth/google · /callbackGuestInitiate and complete Google OAuth 2.0 login (FR 3.2.3)
GET/api/v1/auth/oauth/google/linkAuthenticatedLink Google OAuth identity to an existing signed-in account (user_oauth_providers)
POST/api/v1/auth/refreshGuest (Cookie)Rotate HttpOnly refresh token and blacklist prior jti in Redis
POST/api/v1/auth/logoutAuthenticatedRevoke current access jti (jwt:blacklist:{jti}) and delete refresh session (FR 3.2.8)
GET/api/v1/auth/meAuthenticatedResolve current user profile, system role, and active session context
POST/api/v1/auth/forgot-password · /reset-passwordGuestRequest password reset link/OTP and set new password (FR 3.2.4)
POST/api/v1/auth/change-password · /change-password/send-otp · /change-password/otpAuthenticatedChange current password (direct or OTP-verified, FR 3.2.5)
POST/api/v1/auth/set-password · /unlink/oauthAuthenticatedSet password on OAuth-created account or unlink external OAuth provider
POST/api/v1/auth/link/phone · /verify-phone-otp · /unlink/phoneAuthenticatedBind or remove verified phone number (FR 3.2.6)
POST/api/v1/auth/2fa/setup · /2fa/confirm · /2fa/verify · /2fa/disableAuthenticatedConfigure, verify, or disable TOTP Two-Factor Authentication (FR 3.2.7)
GET/api/v1/auth/sessionsAuthenticatedList active device refresh sessions (user_refresh_tokens)
POST/api/v1/auth/sessions/revoke-othersAuthenticatedTerminate all other active device sessions
POST/api/v1/auth/deactivate/send-otp · /deactivateOwner, Manager, Creator, ClientSelf-deactivate user account after OTP confirmation (FR 3.2.9)

2. Domain 3.3 — User Profile, Notifications & Client Profile ​

Controllers: UserController, UserNotificationController, ClientProfileController, ProfileMatchingController (BA Spec).

MethodPathActorsDescription & SRS Alignment
GET · PUT/api/v1/users/meAuthenticatedView (FR 3.3.1) and update (FR 3.3.2) personal profile
POST/api/v1/users/me/avatar · /me/bannerAuthenticatedUpload public profile avatar or cover banner (s3://.../image/*)
GET/api/v1/users/lookup · /me/completenessAuthenticatedLookup user by email for invitations; inspect profile completeness score
GET/api/v1/notifications/meAuthenticatedList in-app inbox rows (user_notifications, pushed live via /user/queue/notifications)
POST/api/v1/notifications/me/{id}/read · /me/read-allAuthenticatedMark single or all in-app notifications as read
GET · POST/api/v1/client-profile/mine · /api/v1/client-profileOwner, Manager, ClientList reusable Client profiles or create a new client_profiles record (FR 3.3.3)
GET · PUT · DELETE/api/v1/client-profile/{profileId}Owner, Manager, ClientView (FR 3.3.3), update (FR 3.3.4, fixed email), or delete reusable Client profile
POST/api/v1/client-profile/logo · /{profileId}/logoOwner, Manager, ClientUpload draft or bound brand logo for a Client profile

3. Domain 3.4 — Agency, Personal Studio & Workspace (26 FRs) ​

Controllers: AgencyController, WorkspaceController, WorkspaceTemplateController, DashboardAnalyticsController, AnalyticsController (BA Spec).

3.1 Agency & Personal Studio Endpoints (/api/v1/agencies/**) ​

MethodPathActorsDescription & SRS Alignment
GET · POST/api/v1/agenciesOwner, Manager, CreatorList joined companies or create a new AGENCY / PERSONAL company (FR 3.4.1–3.4.2)
GET · PUT · DELETE/api/v1/agencies/{agencyId}Owner (read: members)View details (FR 3.4.2), update company profile (FR 3.4.3), or soft-delete company (FR 3.4.4)
POST/api/v1/agencies/{agencyId}/restoreOwnerRestore soft-deleted Agency within retention grace window
POST/api/v1/agencies/{agencyId}/logo · /bannerOwnerUpload Agency logo and banner
GET/api/v1/agencies/{agencyId}/stats · /workspace-membersOwnerCross-workspace Agency overview metrics & roster (FR 3.4.5)
GET · DELETE/api/v1/agencies/{agencyId}/members · /members/{memberId}OwnerList Agency members (FR 3.4.6) or remove non-Owner member (FR 3.4.9, capped at 1 on PERSONAL)
GET/api/v1/agencies/{agencyId}/members/{userId}/profile · /activityOwnerView member profile and cross-workspace contribution log
GET · POST · DELETE/api/v1/agencies/{agencyId}/invitations · /{invitationId}OwnerList, send (FR 3.4.7, 30-day token), or cancel Agency invitations
GET · POST/api/v1/agencies/invitations/{preview,my-pending,accept,decline}AuthenticatedPreview, list, accept (FR 3.4.8), or decline pending Agency invitations

3.2 Workspace, Templates & Role Dashboards (/api/v1/workspaces/**) ​

MethodPathActorsDescription & SRS Alignment
GET · POST/api/v1/workspaces · /my-managedOwner, Manager, Creator, ClientList accessible workspaces (FR 3.4.11) or create a new Workspace (Owner, FR 3.4.10)
POST/api/v1/workspaces/personal/bootstrapOwnerOne-click Personal Studio + default personal workspace bootstrap (STUDIO_FREE)
GET · PATCH · DELETE/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId} · /settingsOwner, Manager (read: all members)View workspace, update settings/timezone/report schedule (FR 3.4.12), or soft-delete (Owner, FR 3.4.13)
POST/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/restore · /logo · /bannerOwner, ManagerRestore deleted workspace (Owner) or upload workspace branding
GET · POST/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/duplicate-options · /duplicateOwnerClone workspace structure, templates, and settings (FR 3.4.25)
GET/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/dashboardOwner, Manager, Creator, ClientRole-tailored workspace operational dashboard (FR 3.4.26)
GET · POST/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/members · /members/invite · /members/assignOwner, ManagerView workspace roster (FR 3.4.14), invite external user (FR 3.4.15), or assign existing Agency member
PATCH · DELETE/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/members/{memberId}/role · /members/{memberId} · /leaveOwner, Manager, MemberUpdate workspace role (MANAGER | CREATOR, FR 3.4.17), remove member (FR 3.4.18), or leave (BR-19 >= 1 active Manager)
